uncertainties.note: Ryoma/Hayato/Benkei vs. the Invader-controlled Saotome trade taunts across these rows (table order groups the exchange but does not tag speakers). Content and insults are translated faithfully; no line assigns a name beyond what the source's own <color()> tags or immediate context already fix.

Speaker after the Shin Dragon withdraws (row 4732) is not named in-line. Likely Berkt (protective tone toward 'the ship' matches his role commanding Blood Ark forces per glossary), but not asserted as fact in the English.
'She' for the radar contact refers to Cynthia, fixed by the name in row 4692 two rows earlier, not an invented gender.
Speaker (feminine particles) is unidentified; 'she' refers only to Cynthia, the already-established subject of the sentence, not to the speaker.

validation.meaning: Translated directly from the ISO source via tools/dialogue_corpus.py; Japanese was read on console only, never written to disk.
validation.controls: Self-check script (throwaway, run from scratchpad, not committed) re-fetched every row's source via dialogue_corpus.py and compared the ordered list of <...> commands against each target; all 80 rows matched exactly, including rows lacking <ed()> (4662, 4668, 4671, 4672, 4729, 4730, 4733 originally checked, 4735) which were left exactly as the source has them.
validation.fit: All 80 targets are ASCII-only, contain the same newline count as their source row, and are <=110 visible characters (bracket commands and newlines excluded from the count). No row needed shortening beyond ordinary compression.
validation.glossary: Names/terms matched against work/glossary/character_names_021.json, mission_terms_019.json, unit_names_014_a/b.json and work/translation/en/encyclopedia_021_b.json / encyclopedia_022.json: Ryoma (Nagare), Hayato (Jin), Benkei (Kuruma), Saotome, Gainer (Sanga), Cynthia (Lane), Berkt, Marina Carson, Tower, Overman, Invaders, Getter Rays, Shin Dragon, Blood Ark, Dominator all reused as locked; no new terms proposed.
validation.meaning_review: Independent meaning review completed for all rows in this slice (see work/translation/en/dialogue/review_4656.json); 4 rows had 'just'/'just' replaced with 'only'/'anywhere else' to remove the font-unsafe lowercase j (dialogue_04690, dialogue_04695, dialogue_04746, dialogue_04783); no other meaning changes were needed and no row was left unverified.
